svg.title: weightpatch capabilities and required inputs
svg.desc: Shipped in v0.1: six commands (diff, show, apply, revert, stack, screen), sparse bounding-box slices, a content-addressed id over base, parents and edit, pre-image and post-image verification, byte-identical revert, slice-overlap refusal, a GGUF name map with reversed ne order, and JSON output for diff, show and screen. The operator supplies Python 3.12, a base safetensors directory, an edited directory, a .wpatch and, for a screen, one .gguf file.
